study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter observational cohort
cohort: Women at ≥37 weeks of gestation attempting vaginal delivery with live, nonanomalous, singleton, vertex fetuses and no history of cesarean delivery (2008-2011)
finding: Documentation of estimated fetal weight, particularly by ultrasonography, was associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery, especially at higher fetal weight estimates, even after adjusting for birth weight.
mod_finding: Documentation of estimated fetal weight, particularly through ultrasonography, is associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery, especially at higher fetal weight estimates.
birth_weight: All birth weights included, with specific analysis on categories
